page.layout: Two columns of index entries, left and right, under the running head "INDEX." Left column: entries M to N (with the letter N). Right column: entries N to P (with the letters O and P). No page number. Faint show-through of the other side is visible in the middle of the page and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Several readings are doubtful because of fading and show-through: "Maximianistę" (last letter), "5.73.b" (the middle digits), "Paulistæ" and "Pauliani" (the printed text reads "Paulistæ, vel Pau-lianistæ", which is split across lines and has been joined). Entries with a line break in the scan ("Meletiani … 124.b", "Menandriani … 4.b.6", "Metangæi … 155.b") are joined into one line each. The page has no printed page number. The entries "Ophitæ, & Ophiomorphi" and "Pelagiani … 41.b.211." were transcribed as printed.
